description: Craft Agents through its vendor's installer: the AppImage under ~/.craft-agent and a launcher in ~/.local/bin.
why: Two witnesses, ~/.craft-agent and ~/.local/bin/craft-agents, so must_contain names both and removing either value leaves the other to find it. The installer creates ~/.craft-agent before it downloads anything, so the launcher, written last, is what says the install finished. claude-code and claude-desktop are forbidden because the app embeds the Claude Agent SDK and its native `claude` binary, and pi because it embeds the Pi SDK.
known_gaps: The AppImage writes no .desktop entry and leaves no package record, so on Linux the launcher and the directory are all there is to read.
x86_64 only: the vendor ships no arm64 Linux build, so the arm64 runner skips.
